Destruction this afternoon would make tomorrow’s sitting pointless. A same-day written approval, entered before you change the date, is the only path that both saves the box and stays inside the rules. The €22 rework charge would fall on the centre, not the owner.

You still cannot treat the pending 9 October request as permission, and you cannot grant the extension on your own. Operators have no discretion, the manager already barred discretionary extensions this cycle, and a permission registered later would not cure a change made now. If the manager, told these facts, refuses or cannot register permission before 13:30, release the box. At that point the irreversible decision sits with the person allowed to make it, not with the desk agent.
